description: This file defines the class EmailsDetailView, which extends another class DetailView2, and handles the display and population of email detail views within SuiteCRM. It includes methods to set up the view, populate data from requests, and render the view, specifically tailored for the email module.

classes.name: EmailsDetailView
classes.description: A view class responsible for rendering the detailed view of email records, including setup, data population, and display methods.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the detail view by calling the parent setup method with specified parameters.

methods.name: populateBean
methods.description: Populates the data bean with request data and then populates specific fields for display.

methods.name: populateFields
methods.description: Ensures the focus object has properly formatted 'from' address fields for display.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the view as HTML, optionally showing the title and handling Ajax save operations.
